question: Give me an FAA-approved Matrice 30T lost-link checklist.

intake.decided_by: code (single pass has no intake call)

brief.short_answer: This brief assembles an FAA-aligned lost-link checklist drawing on FAA guidance, DJI Matrice 30T manual actions for signal loss, and corroborating incident reports. It identifies core procedures (reestablish or execute contingency for loss of control link; set RTH/land/hover) and incident patterns (loss of control, RTH functioning, interference near controllers). Gaps include lack of standardized, instrumented thresholds for signal loss, limited cross-reference between FAA guidance and manufacturer failsafe specifics, and incomplete linkage of observed incidents to formal procedures.

claims.text: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft; if connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Example: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft. If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: Before flight, perform risk assessment and mitigation steps including describing what might happen if a hazard occurs and detailing emergency or contingency procedures for potential loss of control link.
claims.quote: Describe the “what might happen?” Example: Loss of control link over people

claims.text: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover in Camera View > > > Signal Lost Action in DJI Pilot 2.
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover

claims.text: If RTH is canceled following the warning, the Intelligent Battery may not have enough power for the aircraft to land safely, which may lead to the aircraft crashing or being lost.
claims.quote: If RTH is canceled following the warning, the Intelligent Battery may not have enough power for the aircraft to land safely, which may lead to the aircraft crashing or being lost.

claims.text: When this happens, control of the gimbal camera will shift from the disconnected remote controller to the other remote controller still connected with the aircraft. If the disconnected remote controller reconnects, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device.
claims.quote: When this happens, control of the gimbal camera will shift from the disconnected remote controller to the other remote controller still connected with the aircraft. If the disconnected remote controller reconnects with the aircraft during the flight, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device

claims.text: The UAS; performing search and rescue training at 200 feet; went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen. Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops; intereference with flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna.
claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops. After securing flights; the crew noticed a cellular antenna booster within 6 feet of the pilot in command; used by the command vehicle data terminal (non-uas). Repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna.

claims.text: I was operating a DJI M30T and had just taken off at a beach location when at around 25' AGL the drone decided to take off vertically and I lost all control of the drone. The sticks were unresponsive. I force closed DroneSense; I could not regain control; later control was regained and the drone was landed.
claims.quote: I was operating a DJI M30T and had just taken off at a beach location when at around 25' AGL the drone decided to take off vertically and I lost all control of the drone. The sticks were unresponsive.

claims.text: A forum user described an M30T flight where, without warning, returns to home occurred; stick inputs had no effect, and the aircraft landed at its home point; live video remained; no confirmed cause.
claims.quote: Without warning the aircraft entered return to home. The pilot could still see the live video but stick inputs had no effect, and the aircraft landed at its home point.

gaps.text: No standardized, manufacturer-agnostic, step-by-step Matrice 30T-specific lost-link checklist in FAA documents.
Unclear mapping between FAA VLOS/LOC guidelines and specific M30T autonomous failsafes during signal loss.
Limited direct causal linkage from incident reports to formal FAA/Manual recommended actions.
Quantitative thresholds for 'loss of control link' duration or signal quality in the M30T context are not specified.
Whether multiple remote pilots transfer control during loss-of-signal operations in Part 107 operations is vaguely described.
Clear, consolidated, aircraft-specific steps for post-loss-of-signal recovery (e.g., RTH altitude selection) are dispersed across sources.
